readingNotes: Room IDs and schedule locations use the A9 building code. Suffixes are preserved.
A schedule value of null means no timetable or office-hours notice was photographed for that person.
Where exact start or end times are missing, the corresponding value is null. postedWindow records the enclosing printed column or columns when available.
An adjacent_photos association is based on separate nearby photos. Treat it as a probable room match until confirmed in person.
Timetables retain their posted academic year and term. The records describe what was posted at the time the photos were taken.
Blank timetable cells do not appear in activities. Office-hours entries also appear in the officeHours list for convenient lookup.
